火控防线实验 / Stabilizer Team

地面与防空火控车共用状态和效果，配套双条件地图增援片段
Ground and anti-air vehicles share state and effects, with a two-condition map reinforcement fragment

使用方式 / Getting started
导入 .rwmod，启用并重新加载，在沙盒搜索 rwa07 或 rwa08
Import the .rwmod, enable it and reload, then search the sandbox for rwa07 or rwa08

1 创建稳定火控车和防空火控车，分别面对地面与空中目标
  Create both vehicle types and compare their ground and air target eligibility
2 切换稳定射击和巡航，比较移动速度、弹体颜色与伤害
  Switch between stabilization and cruise, compare movement speed, projectile color and damage
3 留意枪口光与轻微车体动画，再在副本中临时去掉效果引用比较
  Observe the muzzle flash and subtle hull animation, temporarily remove effect references in a working copy for comparison
4 把地图 XML 片段合入有效地图副本，确保队伍 0 已配置，再把两辆防守车移入区域
  Merge the XML fragment into a valid map copy with team 0 configured, then move two defender vehicles into the region

代码学习提示 / Code notes
先在副本中修改一个数值，重新加载后再观察其他组合
Change one value in a working copy and reload before trying combinations

素材许可 / Asset credits
代码与说明为本课程原创，24×24 PNG 复用 Rusted Warfare Mod Academy 的 CC0 教学像素图片
Original lesson code and prose, 24x24 PNG assets reuse the Academy CC0 tutorial pixel sprites
CC0-1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

游戏表现仍需在 Rusted Warfare 1.15 中核实
In-game behavior still requires verification in Rusted Warfare 1.15
